patch_thermal_all.csv: One row per patch-year-season; primary Xu-method T1, regional same-elevation T0, DeltaT, support, slope and footprint elevation.
group_summary_all.csv: Descriptive summaries by Xu slope class and 500 m elevation band.
endpoint_slope_patch_metrics.csv: Patch-derived impervious area, patch count, mean area and patch-domain LSI by slope and year.
landscape_indices_2000_2020.csv: Six Xu landscape metrics by slope and endpoint year.
slope_expansion_changes.csv: Locked area changes and relative growth by slope class.
